claims.subject: Exit cash / negotiable-instrument declaration (statutory)

claims.subject: Unconditional transferability of foreign-loan servicing payments through Authorised Dealer

claims.subject: Unconditional transferability of investment sale or liquidation proceeds through Authorised Dealer

claims.subject: Export of goods or services payment-mode conditions
claims.rule: A person may export goods or services from Nigeria if the goods or services are not prohibited by law in Nigeria, payment is made by letter of credit or any other internationally acceptable mode of payment, and the payment amount represents a fair return for the goods or services.
